findings.message: The `## Scope fence` lists `tickets`. The 19.P3 registry row `rework-stage` fences only chupa/rework.py, specs/rework.md, chupa/mergequeue.py and tests/test_rework.py. Under 19.L, a widening that mechanical rules 2-5 do not find is a plan edit, and none of them reaches the ticket plane here. Rework's split and update ticket-plane commits happen at runtime through the git seam inside the test repos, so they never put `tickets/**` in this diff. A fenced `tickets` prefix also makes the Implement render treat this code ticket as a seeding ticket ('a seeding ticket (its fence includes `tickets`) CREATES each NEW tickets/<seed-stem>/ticket.md'). That invites uncommitted ticket files that the lift would treat as seeds. The fence also breaks 19.L CONTEXT CLOSURE: `tickets` is an existing fenced path, but it is neither embedded in `## Context` nor listed in `## On-demand`.
